_methodology.note: Reference guide, not a bookable activity - Madeira's coastline is mostly volcanic pebble and cliff, so 'best beaches' genuinely means a short list rather than a long one. Every wikipediaTitle was verified to return a working thumbnail.

items.name: Praia Formosa
items.description: Funchal's own beach, a short bus or taxi ride west of the centre. Dark volcanic sand and pebble rather than golden, but free, easy to reach, and popular with locals for an afternoon swim.

items.name: Calheta
items.description: A small artificial beach on the south-west coast with sand shipped in from Morocco - the closest thing to a classic golden-sand beach without leaving the main island.

items.name: Porto Santo
items.description: The real deal - a 9km stretch of fine golden sand on Madeira's sister island, the 'Ilha Dourada'. Reachable by a ~2h15 ferry from Funchal, so it's a full-day trip rather than an afternoon out.
